Hi Sophie — sorry you're hitting this. Quick checklist while I loop in ops: 

1) Can you confirm the email you used to accept the invite (exact address)?
2) Did you open the link behind any link-shortening/redirection (Slack/mobile apps sometimes mangle query params)?
3) If you're using a corporate SSO, did you try an incognito window (to avoid stale eID cookies)?

Ben — tagging you because this looks like a tenant-claim mismatch on redirect (we've seen it when invite redirect drops the rel= or tenant query). If ops needs logs I can ask EscrowLane to reattempt and forward the trace.

Sophie — we'll aim to have a short remediation plan within 2 business days. If it helps, you can try the direct invite again from an incognito session or forward me the header of the link (right-click -> copy link).

Best,

Nice write-up, Steph. Sophie — two things I want to try before we escalate to infra:

- Can you paste the full URL you received (including query string)? If the tenant token is truncated the invite flow fails with that exact message.
- If you have a corporate SSO (SAML) session, the IdP may be returning an unexpected NameID format that doesn't match the tenant claim. Try: accept in an incognito window and explicitly choose 'Continue with email' (if offered) instead of your company's SSO provider.

If you can re-trigger and send me the header capture, I'll run it through our parser. If the token is intact but the claim is different, we may need an ops trace. Marissa — this could be the same rel=redirect trimming bug we saw with BrightMfg last quarter (ONB-442). Can you review and advise whether we need a trace?
